preconditions.description: The length of the array n must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All elements of the array a must be between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(a[u] > a[v] for u in range(n) for v in range(u + 1, n)) else True
postconditions.description: If no inversions exist, the output must be -1.

postconditions.expression: len(pairs) == m and all(1 <= u < v <= n for u, v in pairs)
postconditions.description: The number of pairs m must match the number of inversion pairs listed, and each pair must be valid.

postconditions.expression: sorted(a) == [a[i] for i in sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: a[i]) if i not in {u for u, _ in pairs} | {v for _, v in pairs}]
postconditions.description: After processing all pairs, the array must be sorted in non-decreasing order.
